gates.requirement: One complete fresh 34-route snapshot; two executions of the frozen Quant V2 rules on the identical snapshot must reproduce identical substantive ledgers and metrics.
gates.promotion_effect: Necessary evidence only; no production promotion by itself.

gates.requirement: Reproduce the fixed 26-week evaluation with independently sourced historical data wherever a genuinely separate market-data source exists, preserving the frozen Quant V2 rules and documenting every route's source, timestamp basis, price basis and coverage.
gates.truth_rule: A hybrid provider-diverse replay may be retained as supporting evidence but cannot be called full independent-provider reproduction while any route remains on its primary source.
gates.synthetic_route_rule: V10/V25/V50/V75/V100 are proprietary Deriv markets; provider diversity is not represented as possible. Their independent-evidence path is a separate target-server/broker extraction and reconciliation, not a fictitious second market source.
gates.promotion_effect: Full gate remains fail-closed until the evidence scope is sufficient and explicitly classified.

gates.requirement: Populate target-server evidence for spread cost median/P95, round-turn commission, slippage mean/P95, financing, contract size, tick size/value, min/step/max lot, margin/leverage, stop/freeze levels, execution mode, fill/reject rate, latency median/P95, session/weekend rules and immutable spec hash.
gates.promotion_effect: No production promotion without measured target-server execution provenance.

gates.requirement: Run frozen Quant V2 in non-discretionary shadow mode against certified target broker/server routes and reconcile signal -> requested order -> broker acknowledgement -> fill/reject/partial fill -> management -> exit -> realised/marked P&L, with timestamps and immutable event identifiers.
gates.promotion_effect: Only after this gate and all previous gates pass may Quant V2 be considered for production promotion.
